text:
maya: Noticed a bunch of DAST + SAST job failures in CI after yesterday's KMS rotation. Errors are decrypt/access denied when trying to read evidence blobs.

sec-bot: [ALERT] ci-scan-prod failing 1767778888 - cannot decrypt evidence objects. job: `dast-evidence-collector`.

owen: Can someone paste logs? I want to confirm it's a grant issue not a bucket policy problem.

maya: ```
ERROR: s3:GetObject failed: AccessDenied when decrypting object s3://sec-evidence/2026/03/21/scan-6789.enc
kms:DecryptAccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222:key/rotation-2026-03-20
stack: scanner/collector/kms.go:142
```

janet: Looks like the new key has no aws_kms_grant for role svc-dast-collector. Our rotation script updates alias and secret but doesn't update grants.

infra-oncall: Rolling alias back to previous key for immediate mitigation. Will run smoke tests after.

maya: If we revert, older evidence still decrypts, but new runs will fail until grant is fixed. Also concerned about automated rewraps we run for key retirement.

owen: Two immediate asks: 1) Add a post-rotation smoke check that attempts decrypt as the scanner role, 2) Add terraform check to ensure aws_kms_grant is part of rotation PRs.

sec-bot: Suggested smoke test: run in rotation job 
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::222:role/svc-dast-collector --role-session-name smoke
# export creds then:
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sample.enc --key-id $SAST_KEY_ARN --profile assumed-smoke
```

tariq: I'll patch rotation script to call `terraform apply` for grants and then run the smoke action via GH action. Also add a retry loop to wait for eventual grant propagation.

janet: We should also add an alert metric: `scan.evidence.decrypt.failures` and route to sec-oncall with critical severity. Currently we only get generic job failures.

maya: Agreement. Also need a follow-up to scan history: if any objects were re-encrypted with the rotated key (via rewrap) and are now unreadable, we need a rewrap-back plan or to restore from backup. Owen, can you run a quick audit for objects uploaded after 2026-03-20?

owen: On it. I'll run inventory script: `python infra/tools/s3_kms_inventory.py --bucket sec-evidence --since 2026-03-20` and report orphaned keys.

infra-oncall: CI green after alias revert. Leaving incident note in #incidents.

tariq: Plan of record:
1) emergency revert (done).
2) short-term: rotation script change + GH action smoke test to verify `aws kms decrypt` as scanner role.
3) medium: add terraform check in PR template to include `aws_kms_grant` and a `verify-grants` CI job.
4) long-term: instrument decrypt SLO + PagerDuty routing + monthly audit.

janet: I'll send a PR to the rotation repo with smoke action and a checklist for reviewers. Please include the sample grant command:```
aws kms create-grant --key-id $SAST_KEY_ARN --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::222:role/svc-dast-collector --operations Decrypt
```

maya: Good. Owen please post results of object inventory. I'll open an incident follow-up ticket with action owners: Tariq (rotation), Janet (grant PR), Owen (evidence audit), Maya (SLO/alerts).

nowen: Inventory run started, will post findings in a bit.

maya: Thanks all. Close after PR merge + SLO wired. :thumbsup:
